text: Orlando Health is a private, not-for-profit healthcare organisation headquartered in Florida, with no shareholders and no state stake; it is a 501(c)(3) system. Sponsorship spend is therefore private/non-profit money with no political ownership chain.
short: Orlando Health is a private, not-for-profit healthcare organisation headquartered in Florida, with no shareholders and no state stake; it is a 501(c)(3) system.

source.name: Orlando Health, About Us
source.quote: Orlando Health is a private, not-for-profit healthcare organization with a long tradition of serving its many and varied communities across Florida, Puerto Rico and now into Alabama.
